scope: Targeted primary-source technical review, not an exhaustive systematic review.
status_note: Publication verification, method reading and local implementation testing are different fields. No external method was executed in this review.

sources.title: BioProBench: A Corpus and Benchmark for Biological Protocol Reasoning in Autonomous Science
sources.status: arXiv v4 verified; author repository reports ICML 2026, official proceedings not independently verified
sources.read: SR/SP definition, threshold appendix and metric code
sources.use: Original max-similarity baseline and threshold identity
sources.limit: Does not validate Chinese ClearEval answers, operation-instance coverage or an adapted encoder threshold

sources.title: Unleashing Scientific Reasoning for Bio-experimental Protocol Generation via Structured Component-based Reward Mechanism
sources.status: ICLR 2026 publication verified on official proceedings
sources.read: arXiv v1 sections 3.2–3.3, appendices C/F; public evaluation code, not executed; final conference PDF unavailable
sources.use: Closest prior: action/object/parameter decomposition and structured matching; static code audit
sources.limit: No verified ready solution for free-text Chinese ClearEval, task-scoped evidence and multi-route applicability; main branch not commit-pinned

sources.title: Process-Level Representation of Scientific Protocols with Interactive Annotation
sources.read: Graph task definition, annotation design and model/implementation descriptions
sources.use: Explicit source spans, predicate arguments and cross-sentence relations
sources.limit: Full graph annotation adds labor; does not define ClearEval score dependencies

sources.title: Learning Latent Structures for Cross Action Phrase Relations in Wet Lab Protocols
sources.read: MSTG task definition, implicit arguments, temporal/causal relations and reported experiment summary
sources.use: Represent relations crossing action phrases
sources.limit: No verified drop-in implementation for this project; timing scope is not solved by relation representation alone

sources.title: Multilingual E5 Text Embeddings: A Technical Report
sources.status: Technical report; reviewed venue not verified
sources.read: Report/model card: architecture, languages, prefixes, length and cosine distribution
sources.use: Light multilingual retrieval candidate
sources.limit: Cosine threshold 0.7 cannot transfer from MPNET; not a coverage verifier

sources.title: M3-Embedding: Multi-Linguality, Multi-Functionality, Multi-Granularity Text Embeddings Through Self-Knowledge Distillation
sources.read: Publication metadata/abstract and official model card implementation modes
sources.use: Multilingual dense retrieval candidate
sources.limit: Retrieval evaluation does not establish necessary-step identity or coverage

sources.title: Qwen3 Embedding: Advancing Text Embedding and Reranking Through Foundation Models
sources.status: Technical report; reviewed venue not verified
sources.read: Abstract and official model card including dependency requirements
sources.use: Alternative multilingual retriever
sources.limit: Current portable transformers 4.48.3 is below documented 4.51 minimum; not installed or tested

sources.title: AlignScore: Evaluating Factual Consistency with A Unified Alignment Function
sources.read: Section 3.2 alignment aggregation and official implementation requirements
sources.use: Directional evidence-to-claim support concept
sources.limit: Maximum alignment aggregation does not impose operation-instance multiplicity

sources.title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
sources.read: Atomic fact decomposition and support fraction definition
sources.use: Decompose a claim before checking support
sources.limit: Factual precision is not necessary-operation recall; no Llama estimator is adopted

sources.title: Measuring Attribution in Natural Language Generation Models
sources.read: AIS interpretability/attribution framework, especially section 4.1; not all appendices
sources.use: Determine whether the answer is interpretable before checking reference support
sources.limit: An annotation framework, not automatic completion of omitted answer content

sources.title: Ollama: Structured outputs
sources.read: JSON Schema versus JSON mode and request examples
sources.use: Native format constraint option
sources.limit: Schema does not verify semantics; local server capability not tested in this review

sources.title: XGrammar: Flexible and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Large Language Models
sources.read: Official abstract and implementation README
sources.use: Grammar-constrained generation background
sources.limit: Does not establish factual accuracy or that Ollama uses this engine

sources.title: LangExtract and output schema documentation
sources.status: Official software documentation; not a peer-reviewed paper
sources.read: README, grounding features and provider-specific schema support
sources.use: Source-span grounding design
sources.limit: Current Ollama provider lacks custom output_schema support although native Ollama has schema support

sources.title: G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment
sources.read: Criterion/step-based form-filling evaluation approach
sources.use: Explicit criterion-level evaluation record
sources.limit: Does not define ClearEval Cor/EGES division or prove domain correctness

sources.title: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList
sources.read: Minimum functionality, invariance and directional-expectation test definitions
sources.use: Define the expected response and preconditions of each edit
sources.limit: Does not supply biological validity of a particular edit

sources.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
sources.read: Official abstract and bias summary, not a full reproduction
sources.use: Judge agreement and position/verbosity bias limitations
sources.limit: Repeated agreement does not establish scientific correctness

sources.title: Measuring what Matters: Construct Validity in Large Language Model Benchmarks
sources.read: Core construct-validity concepts and checklist; not all 82 pages
sources.use: Separate task phenomena, metric properties and warranted claims
sources.limit: Conceptual diagnostic guidance, not a ready scorer

sources.title: Temporal Constraint Networks
sources.read: Primary abstract and STP/TCSP distinction; no implementation reproduced
sources.use: Represent interval constraints and separate disjunctive branches
sources.limit: Cannot extract correct phase or time-scope semantics by itself

sources.title: HeidelTime: High Quality Rule-Based Extraction and Normalization of Temporal Expressions
sources.read: Paper abstract/extraction-normalization distinction and official README
sources.use: Distinguish duration recognition from normalization
sources.limit: Does not decide ClearEval incubation scope, cumulative aggregation or optional execution

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.read: Entity, activity and derivation/provenance concepts
sources.use: Record knowledge rows and score-input derivations
sources.limit: Not an algorithm that fixes duplicate-key indexing or validates biology

sources.title: References Matter: Investigating the Impact of Reference Set Variation on Summarization Evaluation
sources.read: Official metadata, abstract and introductory findings; detailed experiment not reproduced
sources.use: Reference-set sensitivity and ranking caution
sources.limit: Summarization evidence does not settle valid tissue-clearing routes

sources.title: Document Overlap Is Not Evidence Continuity: Measuring Retrieval Jitter in Citation-Based RAG Evaluation
sources.read: Method section: fixed queries/embedding/decoding, document versus exact-span stability; result interpretation
sources.use: Record evidence identity changes beneath unchanged scores
sources.limit: Exact span turnover is not automatically semantic evidence change; code link from paper, not executed

sources.title: Increasing Transparency Through a Multiverse Analysis
sources.read: Analysis-choice framework and coherent alternatives
sources.use: Keep reasonable interpretation choices visible
sources.limit: Does not determine which missing experimental value is true

sources.title: Specification curve analysis
sources.read: Framework for defensible specifications; correction notice concerns PDF arrows
sources.use: Report how conclusions vary with predeclared settings
sources.limit: No reason to average invalid or mutually inconsistent configurations

sources.title: Minmax robustness for multi-objective optimization problems
sources.read: Primary abstract and scope, not all proofs
sources.use: Theoretical background for multi-objective uncertainty
sources.limit: Our finite-scenario dominance report is not claimed identical to every formal robust-efficiency definition

sources.title: ReGraph: Learning to Generate Recipe Graphs from Food Images
sources.status: arXiv preprint; reviewed venue not verified
sources.read: Introduction and section 5.2 graph evaluation
sources.use: Adjacent prior work on procedural entity/relation evaluation
sources.limit: Food-image recipe graphs are not validated tissue-clearing score inputs
